decisions.reason: The firm invested in several naval lighting models and mentioned the line, so sunk costs and some public presence make persistence likely.
A dedicated website page signals visible commitment and the product line represents investment that management will be reluctant to write off.
As a core interior luminaire with its own page, it is central to the firm's market and has clear public commitment, supporting continuation.
Its role as the announced flagship makes it central and highly visible, so dropping it would expose failure and write off significant investment.
Although only mentioned and outside the core intelligent-lighting direction, the multi-model marine HMI searchlight line still has sunk costs that encourage persistence.
